description: This PHP class defines the UserAuthProvider entity for ORM, representing external authentication providers associated with users in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for provider type, LDAP details, and relational mapping to the User entity.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Represents an external authentication provider linked to a user, supporting both local and LDAP types within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the auth provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the auth provider.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this auth provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type (local or LDAP).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the provider type (local or LDAP).

methods.name: getLDAPUserHash
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user hash if available.

methods.name: getLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: setLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user unique identifier.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user unique identifier.
